title: Auth, sessions, and JWKS
head_binding_policy: The final PR head SHA is bound by REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at independent reviewer approval time via scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py. This evidence manifest does not claim a commit can contain its own SHA.

delivery_nature.statement: Decoupled all 6 test and support files in the B03 auth_session_jwks partition from the composition root (services/control-plane/bff/main.py) and sys.path surgery while preserving full test contracts, error schemas, and invariants using retained production seams and isolated test harnesses.

composition_root_references.notes: Zero import main or from main import across all 6 files.

sys_path_surgery.notes: All top-level sys.path.insert and sys.path mutations removed across all 6 files.

global_monkeypatching.before: Global monkeypatching of bff_main.session_lifecycle_store, bff_main.auth_facade_service, bff_main.app, and CommandStore.
global_monkeypatching.after: Zero global monkeypatching on composition root; tests construct isolated test harness apps with local session lifecycle stores and explicit router factories.

services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_auth.rationale: Decoupled from main.py by directly exercising services.control_plane.bff.auth.policy seams and create_settings_router with register_error_handlers.

services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_cons.rationale: Decoupled from main.py using isolated ManagementSessionHarness and DynamicHarness with explicit SessionLifecycleStore.

services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_sess.rationale: Decoupled from main.py using isolated ManagementSessionHarness mounting real auth, personas, strategies, and management domain routers.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_au.rationale: Decoupled from main.py by exercising production CORS seams in services.control_plane.bff.core.http_security and auth policy seams.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bf.rationale: Decoupled from main.py by removing sys.path mutations and using package-qualified imports.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_co.rationale: Decoupled from main.py by creating an isolated FastAPI app mounting create_command_adapters_router with register_error_handlers and local CommandStore.
